channel.title: Marin Independent Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Marin Independent Journal (marinij.com)

item.title: Warsofsky makes lineup change as Sharks face Islanders to end homestand
item.description: Philipp Kurashev will be a healthy scratch Saturday when the San Jose Sharks face the New York Islanders

item.title: Marin’s Iranian American community expresses hope amid war
item.description: The attacks by the U.S. and Israel, and the downfall of top leaders in the regime, has unleashed both anxiety and joy for natives of the country.

item.title: San Rafael gets application for 8-story apartment building
item.description: The 105-apartment proposal for 790 Mission Ave. has expanded by more than 38,000 square feet since the preliminary filing.

item.title: Marin employment fair caters to young job seekers
item.description: The annual Marin Youth Job Fair is scheduled for March 18 at the Mill Valley Community Center.

item.title: Boys soccer: Branson captures NorCal crown in shootout
item.description: Branson sophomore Sebastian Le Duc drilled the game-winner to start the celebration as the Bulls won 5-4 in the shootout against Crystal Springs Uplands after the NorCal title match was tied 1-1 at the end of regulation.

item.title: Warriors instant analysis: Porzingis’ return not enough to stop SGA’s march toward historic scoring mark
item.description: Kristaps Porzingis makes his return to the lineup, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander inches closer to Wilt Chamberlain's record

item.title: Larkspur bids farewell to downtown library
item.description: The 113-year-old community hub closed Friday, and its replacement on Rose Lane is set to open in late March.

item.title: Overtime goal sinks San Jose Sharks as homestand comes to an end
item.description: San Jose Sharks center Macklin Celebrini extends point streak to five games against New York Islanders

item.title: Girls soccer: Marin Catholic leaves it late, punches ticket to state
item.description: Siena White received the ball in her own half, split a pair of defenders then pulled away from both of them with a burst of pace that underscored the urgency of being in a tie game inside the final 5 minutes of a NorCal final.

item.title: Boys basketball playoffs: San Marin advances to NorCal title game
item.description: Miller Morgan hit a clutch 3-pointer inside the final 2 minutes and Anthony Elwell added a jump shot as San Marin pulled away late for a 54-47 road win against Rancho Cotate in the NorCal Division V semfinals in Santa Rosa on Saturday.
